citations.quote: The target must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (it chooses which), or it has the Grappled condition. The DC for the saving throw and any escape attempts equals 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus. This grapple is possible only if the target is no more than one size larger than you and if you have a hand free to grab it.

why: Grapple is possible: the target makes a Strength or Dexterity save (its choice) vs DC = 8 + Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus (the attacker's) — supply str_modifier and proficiency_bonus to resolve the number; on a failure, the Grappled condition.
